# D20 Tests

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

Ability checks, saving throws and the modifiers, proficiencies and rerolls that feed into them.

## Entries

- [Ability Check](Ability-Check.md): An ability check is a D20 Test that represents using one of the six abilities—or a specific skill associated with an ability—to overcome a challenge.
- [Ability Score and Modifier](Ability-Score-and-Modifier.md): A creature has six ability scores—Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma—each of which has a corresponding modifier.
- [Advantage](Advantage.md): If you have Advantage on a D20 Test, roll two d20s, and use the higher roll.
- [D20 Test](D20-Test.md): D20 Tests encompass the three main d20 rolls of the game: ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.
- [Difficulty Class](Difficulty-Class.md): A Difficulty Class (DC) is the target number for an ability check or a saving throw.
- [Disadvantage](Disadvantage.md): If you have Disadvantage on a D20 Test, roll two d20s and use the lower roll.
- [Expertise](Expertise.md): Expertise is a feature that enhances your use of a skill proficiency.
- [Heroic Inspiration](Heroic-Inspiration.md): If you (a player character) have Heroic Inspiration, you can expend it to reroll any die immediately after rolling it, and you must use the new roll.
- [Passive Perception](Passive-Perception.md): Passive Perception is a score that reflects a creature's general awareness of its surroundings.
- [Proficiency](Proficiency.md): If you have proficiency with something, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to any D20 Test you make using that thing.
- [Save](Save.md): Save is another name for a saving throw.
- [Saving Throw](Saving-Throw.md): A saving throw—also called a save—represents an attempt to avoid or resist a threat.
- [Skill](Skill.md): A skill is an area of specialization associated with an ability check.
